ERR_SPI_BAD_DEV_CFG.message: The setting of the chip at {cs} on {bus} is not valid (mode, clock or queue)

ERR_SPI_DEV_ADD.message: The chip at {cs} could not be added to {bus}

ERR_SPI_DEV_REMOVE.message: The chip at {cs} could not be removed from {bus}

ERR_SPI_DEV_NOT_ADDED.message: No chip is attached at {cs} on {bus}

ERR_SPI_CS_TAKEN.hint: Give each chip on the bus its own chip select pin.

ERR_SPI_NO_SLOT.message: {bus} has no room for another chip (at most {slots})
ERR_SPI_NO_SLOT.hint: Remove a chip from the bus first.

ERR_SPI_XFER.message: A transfer to the chip at {cs} on {bus} failed
ERR_SPI_XFER.hint: Check the wiring of the bus and the chip.

ERR_SPI_TOO_LONG.message: A transfer of {len} bytes to {cs} on {bus} is longer than its {max}

ERR_SPI_QUEUE_FULL.message: The chip at {cs} on {bus} has {depth} transfers waiting already

ERR_SPI_TIMEOUT.message: The transfers to the chip at {cs} on {bus} did not end within {timeout_ms}
ERR_SPI_TIMEOUT.hint: Check the wiring of the bus and the chip.

ERR_SPI_BUS_INIT.message: {bus} could not start on pins {sclk} (SCLK), {mosi} (MOSI) and {miso} (MISO)
ERR_SPI_BUS_INIT.hint: Check that the pins are free and can be used for SPI.
